name: controlled-conversion-workflow-selection-audit

semanticCorrection: The graph mind-map control is an in-place derived view switch, not a file conversion. Current graph file outputs are Canvas and a generated Markdown project note.

candidates.reason: It already has the narrowest source format, bounded parser, validated internal target, non-overwrite naming and the most complete confirmation surface.
Projection is safe but currently writes immediately; OPML metadata and collapse/layout projection losses need a dedicated disclosure contract.
The output is a point-in-time derived graph snapshot and needs scope and loss language distinct from tabular conversion.
This is a semantic template generator, not a lossless format conversion, and requires separate disclosure of generated tasks and the 100-related-object cap.
